about_the_game:
Traverse the ever-changing maze-like pocket dimension for riches untold! Be warned, only the richest return!

Features

  • A procedurally generated maze that changes every minute for a total of five times in a round.

  • Gold spawns randomly with each generation of the maze: collect it to increase your score.

  • Top 50% of players advance to next round until the winner is decided by a 1v1.

  • Up to 128 players can join a single lobby via Steam lobbies.

  • Competitive gaming reduced down to its bare essentials.

The story so far...

You are a hacker at a competition. Your goal? Accessing the sitting president Ingot Menhir's secret pocket dimension, where he's rumored to store trillions worth of gold! All of a sudden, the screens all go black. "So, you want to obtain my riches, hm?" Menhir's face appears before the masses, with his iconic beady cameras for eyes. Suddenly, all the devices built to access his dimension turn on, fully functional! "THEN MAY THE BEST OF YOU COME TAKE IT! The rest of you? Well, there are fates worse than death... a fitting punishment for testing my patience! AHAHAHAHA!"

It's heisting time!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 8800 GTX (not recommended)

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11.0
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon

name: TIMEHEIST

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support or ARM64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 8800 or AMD equivalent that can run OpenGL 3.3
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
